description: Rotary speaker from Surge: a horn and a bass rotor turning at their own rates through a modelled tube amp, giving pitch shift and tremolo.

params.text: Sets the rotation rate of the horn, 0.0078Hz to 512Hz, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the rotation rate of the bass rotor as a proportion of the horn rate, 0 to 200%.
Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the modelled tube amp, 0 to 100%.
Picks the curve the tube amp saturates with: Soft, Hard, Asymmetric, Sine or Digital.
Sets how much pitch shift the rotation produces, 0 to 100%.
Sets how much level change the rotation produces, 0 to 100%.
Sets the stereo width of the speaker signal, -24dB to 24dB.
Sets how much speaker signal is mixed with the dry input, 0 to 100%.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.
Switches the horn rate from Hz to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by bpm cv.
Puts the modelled tube amp into the signal path; with it off the Gain knob and the Model knob have no effect.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the Horn knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Rotor knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Gain knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Model knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Doppler knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Tremolo knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Width knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Mix knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Sets the tempo that tempo-synced times follow, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V, so 1V gives 120 BPM; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Preset — five factory settings: Subtle, Warble, Warm Rotation, Distorted Doppler and Thats Not What Leslie Wanted.
Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
